laws.title: 100-original-rules
laws.content:
# ARCHIVE 100 – Original Server Rules
*This is an archived rule/law and is no longer in effect.*


```markdown
<:Rules:1115263355989528626>  **Server Rules**
# 📜 **Standard Rules**
Rules that will be enforced with appropriate punishments for violations.

🚫 **No Spamming**
Do not engage in any form of spamming. Violating this rule will result in a temporary mute for a duration of 2-5 minutes, depending on the severity.

🔇 **No Controversial Topics**
Avoid discussing controversial subjects that may cause tension or conflict among members.
<:list_bottom:1117803557513613502>  **07-1 Exception: Controversial Discussion are only allowed in a controled manner, and supervised by server administrators.**

💼 **Advertisements**
While sharing something like YouTube videos, discord servers, etc is allowed, refrain from excessive self-promotion that may disrupt other members' experience. Violations will result in a 2-minute mute.

# 📜 **Critical Rules**
Rules that, if violated, will lead to severe consequences.

🚫 No Harassment, Bullying, or Unpleasant Behavior
Any form of harassment, bullying, or behavior that creates an unpleasant environment will not be tolerated. Victims are encouraged to report incidents to the moderators, and violators will face permanent bans.

Swearing is allowed. Just do not use it as an offense. Slurs are also not tolerated.

🚫 No NSFW Content
Most members in this server are under 18 or may be traumatized if exposed to NSFW content. Please refrain from sharing sexual content, gore, and so on.
📝 This also includes sexual behavior.
📝 And sexual references.

🚫 No Malicious Alt Accounts
Creating alternative accounts without malicious intent is permitted. However, impersonation is strictly prohibited.

# 📜 **Policy Rules**
Rules aimed at guiding new members, with no punishment.

👥 **Reporting Violations**
Please promptly report any rule violations to the moderators. If you feel offended, bullied, or encounter any inappropriate content, capture the messages and submit a report.

📻  **Channels**
Please use channels for their intended purposes. 
@everyone
```

laws.title: 110-original-public-code
laws.content:
# ARCHIVE 110 – Original Public Code
*This is an archived rule/law and is no longer in effect.*\
*This contains redacted texts.*


```text
From the Director of
NIRLEKA STUDIO
[redacted]

PUBLIC CODE
C. August 16, 2024 L.E. August February 188, 20246

We, the people of Nirleka Studio, and affiliations, in order to form a more perfect environment for our members, contractors, and staff, we hereby declare the establishment of the Public Code.

DEFINITIONS
Roles For the purposes of this document, the roles and titles within the Server will be defined as follows:
Server shall refer to the official Nirleka Studio Discord server.
Member shall refer to an online individual who is verified by an administrative entity and present in the Server.
Administrator shall refer to an online individual who is granted permission of administrative and management access to the Server.
Moderator shall refer to an online individual who is an appointed member of the Server granted by an Administrator responsible for maintaining order, and enforcing community guidelines.
(b) Internet Terminologies Common terminologies and slangs used on the internet.
NSFW stands for “Not Safe For Work” refers to contents, websites, attachments, etc. that are not suitable for viewing in public.
Examples include pornographic, violent and gory imagery. 
NSFL stands for “Not Safe For Life” refers to images and videos that are highly disturbing and can potentially inflict psychological trauma for the viewer.
Examples include the violent, gory torture of a person or animal.

ADMINISTRATION
Collection of User Data Once a user has entered the Server, information, which are user IDs, and messages, regardless if they are edited, or deleted, are collected and logged for moderation purposes.
Such data can not be deleted from Server records even if requested. Exceptions may include:


(i) The Data contains any personal information of individuals.
(ii) The Data contains illegal images of child pornography.

(i) Such redaction of such data is to be logged with texts.

PUBLIC CODES
Public Codes shall apply to all individuals present in the Server, regardless of their verification status.

             § 1b. Public Code — Communication
Members of the Server are to act in a civilised, respectful manner towards other members. 
Instances of disrespect, prejudice, and harassment for other Member’s race, sexual orientation, appearance, or religious beliefs, are prohibited.
Sexual behaviour or references are prohibited.
Members are allowed to express themselves with profanities;
Members however are not allowed to express using any type of slurs;
Members are discouraged to discuss politics or religious beliefs that are expressed in a controversial manner that will lead to serious conflicts;
Members are allowed to share and discuss their own projects, community servers, and others unrelated to Nirleka Studio;
Any communication that directly involves or displays an individual's private personal information, including acts of doxing or the dissemination of such information, is strictly prohibited.
Members are prohibited to engage in any kind of spamming behaviour.

             § 2c. Public Code — Media, Links, and Files
Any media contents, audio, images, GIFs, custom emojis, or stickers, must not contain any NSFW or NSFL content that depicts sexual or violent imagery.
Any image that displays private photos, including an individual's face, maps revealing the private location of a person's home, or images of the home itself, is strictly prohibited. This is in accordance with Section 1b (e) of the Public Code.
Any files that contain malware are prohibited.
Any links that will lead to the following are prohibited:
Any malicious websites, such as phishing, and scam sites;
Pornographic sites;
Sites involving illegal activities and materials;

             § 3c. Public Code — User Accounts and Profiles
Alternatives Accounts are subject to regulations:
The account is not used to impersonate another person;
Bypass bans, either from Discord or the Server;
Used to violate Discord's Terms of Service or the Server's Public Code in any way that protects the original perpetrator.
(b) The appearance of user profiles are subject to regulations:
(1) User’s profile picture and banner must not include an NSFW image. This is
      in accordance with Section 2c (a) of the Public Code.
(2) User’s profile description must not contain any contents that violates
      Section 1b of the Public Code.



```

laws.title: 200-lance-admin-reform-act
laws.content:
# ARCHIVE 200 – 1.1 Lance Administration Reformation Act
*This is an archived rule/law and is no longer in effect.*


```text
1.1
Lance Administration Reformation Act
By the Director
Nirleka Studios, Administration


Article 1. Duty.
Lance Administrators shall have the duty to enforce the Public Code.

Article 2. Enforcement.
Lance Administrators are expected to:
Punish an individual who violated the Public Code accordingly. Method of punishments includes:
(1) A timeout, and
(2) Banishment to The Void;
Announce their enforcement actions stated in Art. 2(a)(1) and (2) to #administration-declarations. This announcement should include:
(1) the Public Code violation(s);
(2) the evidence; and
(3) the punishment and its duration if applicable;
Lift their or other Lance Administrator’s punishments after its stated duration.

Article 3. Balancing Powers
The Secretary or the Head Administrator have the power and duties to:
Lift an unlawful or excessive punishment; and
Interpret the Public Code and determine the appropriate punishment.


```

laws.title: 300-original-penal-code
laws.content:
# ARCHIVE 300 – Original Penal Code
*This is an archived rule/law and is no longer in effect.*


```text
2.1
Penal Code
By the Director
Nirleka Studios, Administration

Preamble
The Penal Code is to maintain consistency for punishing Public Code violations and prevent Lance Administrators and other administrators from punishing members excessively or insufficiently.

Administrators are encouraged to follow these codes with the lens of pragmatism.

Article 1. Definitions.
Administrators are to consult the standard Oxford English dictionary for any undefined words.

Article 2. Common Offenses.
Misusing Channels. Not using channels for their intended purpose is not punishable.
Ping Abuse.
	(i) Ping abuse shall be defined as pinging another member that serves no purpose and is purely intended to annoy or harass.
(1) Mass pinging. Repeatedly pinging another member in large amounts can be punished by a 5 minute timeout upon first offense. Second offenses or more should raise the duration in minutes exponentially.
General NSFW.
(1) In accordance to §2c(a) of the Public Code, medias that explicitly depicts nudity, sexual acts, and the presence of fluids that implies sexual activity shall be deleted immediately and timeout the sender for a minimum of six (6) hours. Repeated offenses shall be punished by multiplying the last timeout duration by two (2). The durations may reset after a week. This includes but not limited to:
	(A) Masturbation even if clothed.
	(B) Images that depicts sexual acts even if cropped.
	(C) Images that depict intentional physical contacts of sex organs or other organs used for sexual pleasure.
	(D) Clothings specifically designed for sexual pleasure AND/OR overexposes the wearer.
	(E) Any imagery that depicts sexual acts among other “species” besides humans.
(2) Medias that depict violent imagery and gore that is intended to shock users shall be deleted immediately and timeout the sender for a minimum of twenty-four (24) hours. Repeated offenses shall raise the timeout duration in hours by multiplying the last timeout duration by two (2). Repeated offenses after three (3) counts should constitute a kick. Repeated offenses after two (2) counts should constitute a ban. This includes but not limited to:
	(A) Gore images intended to shock, even if censored or covered.
(3) All previous punishments does NOT include:
	(A) Real life images that capture such violent imagery, and are intended to encourage discussion. Senders of such images shall be encouraged to use the spoiler tag if not already. If the image is too graphic such as close-up of terminal injuries, depiction of rape, etc. then it is to be deleted immediately and warn the sender.
	(B) Images that certainly depict the character, reference, or originating from a pornography, and does not necessarily depict sexual acts.
	(C) Images that does not necessarily depict sexual acts but is created by a creator famous for creating pornographies. Unless the creator is problematic such as having a history of depicting under-age characters in sexual acts.
	(D) Adult novelties that do not necessarily have the form of a body part or other organs. This includes but is not limited to certain types of vibrators.
	(E) Images that depict surgical operations in a clinical context.
CSAM.
(1) Definition. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) shall be defined in this server as the visual, digital, or audio documentation of the sexual exploitation or abuse of a real person under the age of consent defined under their own state’s laws. This does not include:
	(A) Fictional drawings not based on real life events or persons.
	(B) AI generated content.
(2) Enforcement.
	(A) Members posting contents defined in Art. 1(d)(1)(A) and (B) shall be punished by timeout for 1 week. Should such members send the same type of content, or worse, again, they shall be banned.
	(B) Members posting contents defined in Art. 1(d)(1) shall be banned immediately.
Advertising or Self-Promotion. (1) Only punishable if:
	(A) The advertising is constant and/or disruptive to other members; and / or
	(B) The member’s sole intention in the server is to advertise.
(2) Enforcement. Members doing Art. 1(e)(1)(A) and (B) are to be asked to stop. If non-compliant, and repeats it, they shall be timed out for two (2) hours. Should the member repeat the action again, they shall be timed out again with the duration of the previous timeout multiplied by two (2). After three counts, they are to be kicked.

Should the member rejoin and repeat the actions again, they shall be banned.
Discord’s Terms of Service. Administrators shall not punish members solely for violating Discord’s ToS unless such violations also violate the Public Code.
Evading punishment through alternative accounts. Any member caught evading punishment such as timeouts, kicks, and bans using an alternative account, the alternative account shall be timed out based on the Administrator’s discretion depending on the severity of the punishment they are trying to evade.
Spamming. Spamming shall be punished depending on severity. The intentional spamming by one or more members is prohibited if it:
Disrupts anyone’s ongoing conversation of the channel being spammed; and / or
Violates Art.1(b);






```

laws.title: 400-original-admin-codes
laws.content:
# ARCHIVE 400 – Original Administration Codes
*This is an archived rule/law and is no longer in effect.*



```text
Doc. No. 3
    Of 2026
Administration Code
Compilations
Of 26th April 2026, last edited on the 1st June 2026
______________________________________________________________________________

The Administration Branch of Nirleka Studios Discord Server,
by power given to us as Administrators by the Director, decrees:

Part I. Definitions.

Art. 1. Active voter. Refers to members of the server who have cast a vote within the last 90 days, and all members of the Administration unless explicitly stated otherwise.

Art. 2. Predatory Conduct. Refers to any attempt by a member to establish an inappropriate relationship with a minor or a vulnerable member through deceptive or manipulative means. This includes:
Isolate. Attempting to move conversations to private, unmonitored spaces specifically to bypass community oversight.
Gift or Favour Bribery. Using administrative perks, roles or external gifts to create a sense of obligation or dependency.
Sexualization. Introducing sexual topics or requests for private imagery into a relationship with a minor or subordinate.
Secrecy. Explicitly coaching a member to hide their interactions with the officer from their parents, peers, or other administrators.
Art. 3. Administrator. Refers to:
Lance Administrators;
Senior Administrators;
The Head Administrator; and
The Secretary.
Art. 4. Banishment (to the Void). Refers to the act of removing all the roles of a member and add the role Banished to the Void, causing them to only see the channel #the-void and the #rules channel.
Part II. Amendments.
Art. 1. All members of Administration may request a modification.
Art. 2. The Secretary has the final say on if a modification is lawful or not.
Art. 3. Ideally, the Head Administrator or their stated direct subordinate should make the actual modification to maintain plain, precise, legal, and absolute neutral writing.
Part III. Administration Codes.

Art. 1. Members shall not use an alternative account to add another vote to a vote. Suspected members shall be warned and be told that their vote should be removed. Failure to comply may result in a banishment to the Void for a week. Repeated offenses shall lead to a kick.

Art. 2. Members of Administration shall maintain a respectful manner towards other members. Violation shall result in:
A warn; If previous action still persist in such behavior, punishment shall escalate to:
Timeout for a minimum duration of 24 hours;
Repeat offenses shall double the timeout duration from the previous one;
After three offenses, such behavior shall be informed to the Secretary and request the removal of such member from their position.

Art. 3. An Administrator shall state the reason for the deletion of a message by another member. Such action should be justifiable under the Public or Penal Code. Such administrator not providing a justifiable reason shall be punished by:
A warn; If previous action still persist in such behavior, punishment shall escalate to:
Timeout for a minimum duration of 48 hours;
After a second offense, such behavior shall be informed to the Secretary and request the removal of such member from their position.

Art. 4. Impeachment.

Sec. 1. Definition. An impeachment is the act of accusing and removing a member from Administration for gross violation of the Public and/or Penal Code. This includes but not limited to:
Sending explicit pornographic or violent content; and
Predatory conduct to other members.

Sec. 2. Criteria. A member of Administration can only be impeached as defined in Art. 4(1).

Sec. 3. Procedure. A member of Administration can only be impeached through the following steps:
Any member requests the impeachment of a member of Administration;
Any member of Administration is required to call a public vote, with the options of:
Yes. A member chooses to impeach the individual;
No. A member does not choose to impeach the individual; and
Abstain. The member declines to cast a choice for or against the impeachment.
If two-thirds (2/3) of the total active voters are in favor of impeachment, the individual is impeached and shall be removed from their position; or
If Art.4(3)(c) fails, the individual is not impeached.

Sec. 4. Voting. The individual being impeached cannot cast a vote, if they do their vote is invalid.

Art. 5. Negligence. If an Administrator is fully aware, including actively reading or knowing they receive messages requesting an immediate intervention of a major violation, they shall be punished by:
Warned on the first offense.
Removed from their position after the second offense.

Art. 6. Serving Time of Lance Administrators.
A Lance Administrator can only serve for 6 weeks before a majority vote is called for them to stay in position.
Starting on the 27th of April 2026, all currently serving Lance Administrators have 6 weeks left to serve.

Art. 7. Documentation of Moderation Actions. All Administrators are required to document and log any moderation actions in dedicated channels. This includes but not limited to:
Deletion of messages; and
The Banishment, timeout, kick, or ban of a member.

Art. 8. The power to add and remove server bots rests with the Head Administrator and their delegated staff.

Art. 9. Any members of Administration that will willingly accept any form of compensation by another individual in exchange of administrative influence shall be punished by removal from position and banned from taking any position in Administration.

Art. 10. The deliberate deletion or tampering of logs shall be punishable by timeout with the duration of 7 days. Should such a user commit a second offense, they shall be permanently removed from their position.

Art. 11. Celebration of Certain Events.
Administrators or any members that manages events shall not organize, host, or promote any events, or programming centered around recognized holidays and cultural observances (including, but not limited to, religious, federal, state, or national holidays, and designated heritage or awareness months) that is not included in the following section (b).
Permitted events includes:
Easter;
Halloween;
Thanksgiving;
Christmas;
Eid al-Fitr;
Eid al-Adha;
Valentines Day;
Mother’s Day;
Father’s Day;
New Year;
Any country’s celebration on workers’ rights; and
Any country's Independence Day or Victory Day.
The addition or removal of any items in section (b) can only be permitted by a server-wide vote with a two-thirds majority.

Art. 12. An Administrator cannot abuse their power for personal gain, out of irritation, pettiness, and / or sheer spite. Punishment shall be a 24 hour time out. And they shall be removed from their position on the second offense.
Part IV. The Executive Branch.

Art. 1. Composition and General Duties.
The Executive Branch shall be responsible for the enforcement of the Public and Penal Code, maintenance of order, and the general administration of the server. All members of the Executive Branch are bound by the bylaws and may not exercise powers beyond those explicitly granted to their respective role. The Executive Branch shall consist of following ranks:
Lance Administrator;
Senior Administrator, and
The Head Administrator.

Art. 2. Lance Administrator.

Sec. 1. Role. The Lance Administrator is the entry-level enforcement role of the executive branch. Lance Administrators serve as the first line of moderation and are expected to be active, present, and responsive to member conduct.

Sec. 2. Powers. Lance Administrators shall have the power to:
Issue timeouts and warns to members as stated in the Penal Code and this code;
Banish members to the Void;
Delete messages that violate the Public or Penal Code; and
Kick members from the server.
Sec. 3. Limitations. Lance Administrators shall not have the power to:
Issue temporary or permanent bans;
Override or reverse the decisions of Senior or Head Administrators;
Add or remove roles from a member, including themselves, that are not necessary for the enforcement of the Public, Penal, or this Administration Codes or not authorised by Senior Administrators or the Head Administrator.

Art. 3. Senior Administrator.

Sec. 1. Role. The Senior Administrator is the intermediate enforcement role of the executive branch. Senior Administrators have the duty to:
Supervise Lance Administrators;
Punish them for violations according to the Public, Penal, and this Code;
Handle escalated moderation matters; and
Carry expanded enforcement authority granted by the Head Administrator.

Sec. 2. Powers.
All powers granted to Lance Administrators;
Issue temporary or permanent bans;
Review and reverse moderation decisions made by Lance Administrators; and
May appoint a Lance Administrator if members have voted so.
Sec. 3. Limitations. Senior Administrators shall not have the power to:
Unilaterally appoint or demote members of the executive branch;
Reverse decisions made by the Head Administrator; and
Act on disputes in which they are personally involved.

Art. 4. Head Administrator.

Sec. 1. Role. The Head Administrator is the highest authority within the executive branch. The Head Administrator has the ultimate responsibility for the conduct of the executive branch, the integrity of enforcement, and the structural operation of the server.

Sec. 2. Powers.
All powers granted to Lance and Senior Administrators;
Appoint, demote, suspend, or remove members of the executive branch;
Overturn or uphold any moderation decision made by any executive branch member; and
Issue binding directives to the executive branch.

Art. 5. Electing Lance Administrators.
Sec. 1. Election Day. Starting from the 27th of April 2026, for every 6 weeks, Lance Administrators who have served for 6 weeks shall be removed from their position if they are not currently managing a conflict. If they are, they can be removed if another Administrator can take care of it.
Sec. 2. Preparation. Before the election day, preferably a week before, the Secretary shall compile a list of candidates. With the criterias of:
They must be active on the server;
Have done zero intentional or reckless violations of the Public, Penal, and this Administration Codes;
Shall not have already served as Lance Administrator for more than 2 terms and;
They want to serve in the first place.
Sec. 3. Voting. After all Lance Administrators who have served their time have been removed accordingly, a vote shall be called, with a minimum duration of three (3) days, where the options are the list of candidates defined in Sec. 2.
Only a maximum of two (2) candidates can be voted.
Members of Administration or their candidates themselves cannot cast a vote. Otherwise it is invalid.
Sec. 4. Finalisation. After the vote is finished, if a candidate has the majority vote, they shall be promoted as Lance Administrator.

Part V. Temporary Roles.

Art. 1. The Secretary.

Sec. 1. Powers The Secretary shall have the power to:
Form a body within Administration and give them the powers to enforce the Public, Penal, and this Administration Codes for server members and members of Administration;
Appoint someone to said body; and
Dissolve said body.

________________________________________________________________

Authored by:
Dir. Nirleka (3.5.2026)
Sen. Adm. Alice Grace (30.4.2026)



```

# SR 0.1 — Extraterritorial Matters Code

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted in accordance to Chapter 4 of the Server Charter (SR 100). Applies to all members of the Server and members of Administration.

---

## Chapter 1: General Provisions

### Section 1: Purpose and Definitions

#### Art. 1 Purpose
<sup>1</sup> This Code's purpose is described in the following:\
a. To outline cross-server and real-life matters;

b. Restrict Administrators' powers to punish users for a violation they committed outside the server; and

c. To give power to Administrators to keep members of the Server safe from bad actors.

#### Art. 2 Definitions
In this Code:

a. *off-Server* means anything off-Server. This may include other Discord servers, games, platforms, and real-life.

### Section 2: Principles

#### Art. 3 Administrative principles
<sup>1</sup> Administration is under no obligation to investigate off-Server conduct absent a report from a member or credible external source.

<sup>2</sup> The Administration shall maintain a balance between fairness, members' safety, and Administrators' sanity.

#### Art. 4 Punishing actions committed off-Server 
<sup>1</sup> The power to punish members for what they committed off-Server shall be restricted under this Code and laws under SR Category 0.

<sup>2</sup> In accordance to Art. 1. (Principle of Legality) of the Server Charter (SR 100), the Server shall make all members aware that they can be punished for some actions they committed off-Server.

#### Art. 5 Eligibility for punishment
<sup>1</sup> As a principle, a member shall only be punished for actions off-Server to protect the safety of the Server.

<sup>2</sup> Punishable actions includes, but are not limited to:

a. predatory conduct;
b. doxxing another user;
c. targeted harassment, blackmail, or credible threats of harm; and
d. malicious distribution of malware, phishing links, scams, and other illegal materials.

#### Art. 6 Administrative discretion
The Head Administrator and Director reserves the sole right to assess severity and determine appropriate administrative action.

#### Art. 7 Burden of proof
In accordance to Art. 3 (Presumption of Innocence) of the Server Chapter, substantial and verifiable proof is required to punish a member.

#### Art. 8 Suspension
<sup>1</sup> A suspension is an act of temporarily pausing all Server DMs and banning the alleged member from the Server.

<sup>2</sup> No messages from the alleged member shall be removed when banning.

<sup>3</sup> If substantial evidence for an allegation is presented, Administrators can suspend the alleged member immediately, and Art. 8 must follows.

#### Art. 9 Right to due process
<sup>1</sup> In accordance to Art. 2 (Due process) of the Server Charter, alleged members have the right to due process.

<sup>2</sup> Before suspension, Administrators shall send a DM message to the alleged member on the situation.

<sup>3</sup> During suspension, an Administrator shall remain reasonably available to receive a defence from the alleged member during the suspension period.

<sup>4</sup> If the alleged member defended with substantial counter-evidence, suspension shall be lifted.

<sup>5</sup> If the alleged member outright refuses or did not respond to defend themselves, Server DMs can be opened after 24-hours while the alleged member maintains their suspension until paragraph 4 is met.

## Chapter 2: Specific Provisions

### Section 1: Problematic platforms

#### Art. 10 Problematic platforms
A problematic platform is any Discord server or other community platforms that is largely and openly infested with bad actors and / or the platform's administration and / or owner are bad actors themselves.

#### Art. 11 Members in problematic platforms
<sup>1</sup> A member of the Server prohibited to be in any problematic platforms.

<sup>2</sup> A member of the Server that is in or associated with problematic platforms shall be suspended immediately.

<sup>3</sup> Victims, lurkers, or researchers, members who stay in a malicious server purely to monitor safety threats against themselves or their friends are exempt from paragraph 1 and 2.

<sup>4</sup> Victims shall be asked to leave the servers immediately. Failure to comply shall result in a suspension.

### Section 2: Registered sex offenders

#### Art. 12 Accounts
<sup>1</sup> A member of the Server whose account is operated by a confirmed registered sex offender shall be suspended immediately.

<sup>2</sup> A member shall only be confirmed via a public sex offender registry or equivalent official record.

# SR 100 — Charter of the Nirleka Studios Discord Server
*(Server Charter)*

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted as the primary governing document of the Nirleka Studios Discord Server. All lower codes, regulations, executive decisions, and administrative guidelines derive their authority from this Charter and must comply with its provisions.

## Preamble
In the name of The Cat!

The Director of Nirleka Studios,

in an attempt to maintain a unified and civil Discord server as apparently simply stating « Don't be a dick » is not enough,

to both establish rights for all members, constraining their so-called freedom under law to prevent « dickish behaviours »,

to both give power to the Administrators to enforce the law and restrict their profound ego,

to assert that all persons are equally worthless, made by the hands of a single Creator,

to maintain unity across all members, and shall they continue to discuss and do their non-degenerate niches,

while mutually recognising each-other that their differences do not mean for shit in the eyes of The Cat,

and recognising that a mere Discord server with full democracy is simply impossible due to the nature of a Discord server,

decrees:

---

## Chapter 1: General Provisions

### Section 1: Fundamentals

#### Art. 1 The Server
The Director is the owner of the Nirleka Studios Discord Server.

#### Art. 2 Aims
<sup>1</sup> The Server is a place for persons to discuss, share, and practice some various broad and niche topics.

<sup>2</sup> It must promote a common ground and unity among members.

<sup>3</sup> It must protect the security of itself and its members, and prevent the infestation of degeneracy.

#### Art. 3 Official language
The official language of the Server is British English.

#### Art. 4 Rule of Law
<sup>1</sup> The Server's activities must be based on and limited by the Rule of Law.

<sup>2</sup> Server activity must be in the public interest and proportional to the goals pursued.

<sup>3</sup> Server bodies and persons must act in good faith.

### Section 2: Fundamental Member Rights and Guarantees

#### Art. 5 Equality before the Law
<sup>1</sup> Every person is equal before the law.

<sup>2</sup> A person's natural characteristics, personal identity, beliefs, and sexual orientation are in no interest of the Server.

#### Art. 6 Principle of Legality
<sup>1</sup> A member must not be punished for an act that was not a violation under established law at the time it was committed.

<sup>2</sup> Retroactive enforcement and penalties are prohibited.

#### Art. 7 Due process
<sup>1</sup> No member may be banned, kicked, or penalised without:\
a. formal notice specifying the alleged violation;\
b. an explicit citation of the violated law; and\
c. an opportunity to submit an appeal.

<sup>2</sup> Temporary actions taken during emergency situations remain subject to review under paragraph 1.

#### Art. 8 Presumption of innocence
Every member is presumed innocent. The burden of proof rests on the enforcing authority to establish a violation using verifiable evidence.

#### Art. 9 Access to logs and records
<sup>1</sup> Members have the right to access and view the audit logs, moderation actions, related internal communications, and modifications of laws upon request.

<sup>2</sup> Information restricted under Article 10 is exempt from public disclosure.

#### Art. 10 Data protection and deletion
<sup>1</sup> User messages and IDs are collected solely for moderation and security purposes.

<sup>2</sup> Administrators must not preserve, and must immediately delete:\
a. unredacted personal information; and\
b. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or severe illegal content, which must be deleted and reported to Discord Safety.

---

## Chapter 2: Administration Structure

### Section 1: Executive Branch

#### Art. 11 Composition and duties
<sup>1</sup> The Executive Branch is responsible for enforcing Server laws, maintaining order, and managing server operations.

<sup>2</sup> The Executive Branch consists of:\
a. Lance Administrator;\
b. Senior Administrator; and\
c. The Head Administrator.

<sup>3</sup> Members of the Executive are bound by this Charter and lower codes, and must not exercise powers beyond those explicitly assigned to their roles.

#### Art. 12 Lance Administrator
<sup>1</sup> Lance Administrators serve as entry-level moderators.

<sup>2</sup> Lance Administrators have the authority to:\
a. issue warnings and timeouts under the Penal Code;\
b. restrict members to designated channels (*Banishment to the Void*);\
c. delete messages that violate rules; and\
d. kick members from the server.

<sup>3</sup> Lance Administrators must not:\
a. issue permanent bans;\
b. override decisions of higher administrators; or\
c. modify roles outside outlined enforcement procedures.

<sup>4</sup> The number of active Lance Administrators is determined by server population:\

<sup>1</sup> User messages and IDs are collected solely for moderation and security purposes.

<sup>2</sup> Administrators shall not preserve, and shall immediately delete:

*(Server Charter)*

## Title 1: Member Rights and Guarantees

### Section 1: Fundamental Rights

#### Art. 1 Principle of Legality
<sup>1</sup> No member shall be punished for an act that was not defined as a violation by established law at the time it was committed.

<sup>2</sup> Retroactive enforcement and penalties are prohibited.

#### Art. 2 Due Process
<sup>1</sup> No member may be banned, kicked, or penalised without:
a. formal notice specifying the alleged violation;
b. an explicit citation of the violated law; and
c. an opportunity to submit an appeal.

<sup>2</sup> Temporary actions taken during emergency situations remain subject to review under paragraph 1.

#### Art. 3 Presumption of Innocence
Every member is presumed innocent. The burden of proof rests on the enforcing authority to establish a violation using verifiable evidence.

#### Art. 4 Access to Logs and Records
<sup>1</sup> Members shall have the right to access and view the audit logs, moderation actions, related internal communications, and modifications of laws upon requested.

<sup>2</sup> Information restricted under Article 5 is exempt from public disclosure.

#### Art. 5 Data Protection and Deletion
<sup>1</sup> User messages and IDs are collected solely for moderation and security purposes.

<sup>2</sup> Administrators shall not preserve, and shall immediately delete:
a. unredacted personal information; and
b. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or severe illegal content, which shall be deleted and reported to Discord safety.

---

## Title 2: Administration Structure

### Section 1: Executive Branch

#### Art. 6 Composition and Duties
<sup>1</sup> The Executive Branch is responsible for enforcing the Public and Penal Codes, maintaining order, and managing server operations.

<sup>2</sup> The Executive Branch consists of:
a. Lance Administrator;
b. Senior Administrator; and
c. Head Administrator.

<sup>3</sup> Members of the Executive are bound by this Charter and lower codes, and shall not exercise powers beyond those explicitly assigned to their roles.

#### Art. 7 Lance Administrator
<sup>1</sup> Lance Administrators serve as entry-level moderators.

<sup>2</sup> Lance Administrators have the authority to:
a. issue warnings and timeouts under the Penal Code;
b. restrict members to designated channels (*Banishment to the Void*);
c. delete messages that violate rules; and
d. kick members from the server.

<sup>3</sup> Lance Administrators shall not:
a. issue permanent bans;
b. override decisions of higher administrators; or
c. modify roles outside outlined enforcement procedures.

<sup>4</sup> The number of active Lance Administrators is determined by server population:
a. under 40 members: minimum of 1;
b. 40 to 99 members: minimum of 2, maximum of 4;
c. 100 to 299 members: maximum of 6;
d. 300 to 500 members: maximum of 10.

#### Art. 8 Senior Administrator
<sup>1</sup> Senior Administrators supervise Lance Administrators, manage escalated cases, and enforce compliance within the Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> Senior Administrators hold all powers of Lance Administrators, and may:
a. issue temporary or permanent bans; and
b. review and reverse decisions made by Lance Administrators.

<sup>3</sup> Senior Administrators shall not act on disputes in which they are personally involved or reverse decisions of the Head Administrator.

<sup>4</sup> The maximum number of Senior Administrators is calculated as $1 + \log_2(N/20)$ for $N$ total members (minimum of 1 at 20 members).

#### Art. 9 Head Administrator
<sup>1</sup> The Head Administrator oversees operations of the Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> The Head Administrator has authority to:
a. appoint, demote, suspend, or remove Executive Branch members;
b. issue executive directives;
c. manage server bot integrations, roles, and channel permissions; and
d. overturn or uphold any executive moderation decision.

---

### Section 2: Judiciary Branch

#### Art. 10 The Secretary
<sup>1</sup> Judicial authority and legal oversight rest with the Secretary.

<sup>2</sup> The Secretary is responsible for ensuring compliance with the Charter and Public Code, and serves as the final authority on the legal validity of moderation actions and rule changes.

<sup>3</sup> The Secretary has authority to:
a. form judicial or investigative committees within Administration;
b. appoint or dissolve members of such committees; and
c. review appeals and void invalid administrative actions.

---

### Section 1: Elections

#### Art. 11 Election of Lance Administrators
<sup>1</sup> Elections for Lance Administrators shall occur every six (6) weeks.

<sup>2</sup> Serving Lance Administrators who have completed a 6-week term shall step down prior to the vote, unless actively managing an unresolved case that cannot be transferred.

<sup>3</sup> The election procedure:
a. one week before the election, the Secretary shall compile a list of eligible candidates who consent to run;
b. the Secretary shall publish a server-wide poll lasting three (3) days;
c. members may vote for up to two (2) candidates.

<sup>4</sup> Candidates receiving a majority of cast votes shall be appointed as Lance Administrators.

<sup>5</sup> If there are no Lance Administrators left in the Administration, the Secretary shall call an emergency election within 24 hours lasting 24 hours.

<sup>6</sup> If the Server has no members left to be elected as Lance Administrators, the Administration may hold the six (6) week timer until eligible members are available.

---

### Section 2: Referendums and Impeachment

#### Art. 12 Vote of No Confidence
<sup>1</sup> A Vote of No Confidence is a server-wide referendum that, if passed, removes the entire Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> To initiate a referendum, a petition must be submitted to the Secretary containing signatures of at least 15% of active members.

<sup>3</sup> Upon validating the petition, the Secretary shall issue a poll lasting six (6) days within 24 hours. Sitting Executive members and their appointees cannot vote.

<sup>4</sup> The motion passes if:
a. a two-thirds (66% + 1) majority of cast votes favour removal; and
b. a minimum voter quorum of 25% of active members is met.

<sup>5</sup> If a motion fails, a 30-day cooldown period applies before another petition may be submitted.

<sup>2</sup> The Secretary shall review the petition and hold a public poll that:
a. lasts for at least three (3) days; and
b. with the options: *Yes*, *No*, and *Abstain*.

<sup>3</sup> An Administrator is removed immediately if a simple majority (50% + 1) of voting members vote in favour. The accused Administrator cannot vote on their own impeachment.

---

## Title 4: Supremacy and Amendments

### Section 1: Authority and Revisions

#### Art. 15 Supremacy of the Charter
<sup>1</sup> This Charter is the primary governing law of the server.

<sup>2</sup> Any lower code (including the Public Code, Penal Code, and Administration Codes), executive decision, or channel rule that conflicts with this Charter is invalid and unenforceable.

#### Art. 16 Amendments.

d. overturn or uphold any executive moderation decision.

---

### Section 2: Judiciary Branch

#### Art. 10 The Secretary
<sup>1</sup> Judicial authority and legal oversight rest with the Secretary.

<sup>2</sup> The Secretary is responsible for ensuring compliance with the Charter and Public Code, and serves as the final authority on the legal validity of moderation actions and rule changes.

<sup>3</sup> The Secretary has authority to:
a. form judicial or investigative committees within Administration;
b. appoint or dissolve members of such committees; and
c. review appeals and void invalid administrative actions.

---

## Title 3: Elections, Referendums, and Removal

### Section 1: Elections

#### Art. 11 Election of Lance Administrators
<sup>1</sup> Elections for Lance Administrators shall occur every six (6) weeks.

<sup>2</sup> Serving Lance Administrators who have completed a 6-week term shall step down prior to the vote, unless actively managing an unresolved case that cannot be transferred.

<sup>3</sup> The election procedure:
a. one week before the election, the Secretary shall compile a list of eligible candidates who consent to run;
b. the Secretary shall publish a server-wide poll lasting three (3) days;
c. members may vote for up to two (2) candidates.

<sup>4</sup> Candidates receiving a majority of cast votes shall be appointed as Lance Administrators.

<sup>5</sup> If there are no Lance Administrators left in the Administration, the Secretary shall call an emergency election within 24 hours lasting 24 hours.

<sup>6</sup> If the Server has no members left to be elected as Lance Administrators, the Administration may hold the six (6) week timer until eligible members are available.

---

### Section 2: Referendums and Impeachment

#### Art. 12 Vote of No Confidence
<sup>1</sup> A Vote of No Confidence is a server-wide referendum that, if passed, removes the entire Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> To initiate a referendum, a petition must be submitted to the Secretary containing signatures of at least 15% of active members.

<sup>3</sup> Upon validating the petition, the Secretary shall issue a poll lasting six (6) days within 24 hours. Sitting Executive members and their appointees cannot vote.

<sup>4</sup> The motion passes if:
a. a two-thirds (66% + 1) majority of cast votes favor removal; and
b. a minimum voter quorum of 25% of active members is met.

<sup>5</sup> If a motion fails, a 30-day cooldown period applies before another petition may be submitted.

#### Art. 13 Caretaker Administration
<sup>1</sup> Upon passage of a Vote of No Confidence:
a. all Executive Branch members are removed from their positions and lose administrative permissions;
b. the Secretary assumes the position of Caretaker Administrator.

<sup>2</sup> The Caretaker Administrator has authority only to maintain basic security and delete severe violations (such as illegal content), and shall not issue permanent bans, modify roles, or change server settings.

<sup>3</sup> The Secretary shall hold an emergency election for a new Executive Branch within 48 hours.

#### Art. 14 Individual Impeachment
<sup>1</sup> Members may petition for the impeachment of an Administrator accused of misconduct, illegal acts, or unpunished rule violations.

<sup>2</sup> The Secretary shall review the petition and hold a public poll that:
a. lasts for at least three (3) days; and
b. with the options: *Yes*, *No*, and *Abstain*.

<sup>3</sup> An Administrator is removed immediately if a simple majority (50% + 1) of voting members vote in favor. The accused Administrator cannot vote on their own impeachment.

---

## Title 4: Supremacy and Amendments

### Section 1: Authority and Revisions

#### Art. 15 Supremacy of the Charter
<sup>1</sup> This Charter is the primary governing law of the server.

<sup>2</sup> Any lower code (including the Public Code, Penal Code, and Administration Codes), executive decision, or channel rule that conflicts with this Charter is invalid and unenforceable.

#### Art. 16 Amendments.
<sup>1</sup> The Director, based on a majority vote on the 19th of June 2026, shall have the power to unilaterally modify all laws governing this server.

<sup>2</sup> All amendments and passing of laws and regulations shall be publicly announced.

#### Art. 17. Official Language.[^1]
<sup>1</sup> The official language is British English.

<sup>1</sup> Any laws written in another language other than English shall have no legal force.

---

[^1]: Adopted unilaterally by The Director on 11 Aug. 2026, in force since 11 Aug. 2026.

# SR 100 — Charter of the Nirleka Studios Discord Server
*(Server Charter)*

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted as the primary governing document of the Nirleka Studios Discord Server. All lower codes, regulations, executive decisions, and administrative guidelines derive their authority from this Charter and must comply with its provisions.

## Title 1: Member Rights and Guarantees

### Section 1: Fundamental Rights

#### Art. 1 Principle of Legality
<sup>1</sup> No member shall be punished for an act that was not defined as a violation by established law at the time it was committed.

<sup>2</sup> Retroactive enforcement and penalties are prohibited.

#### Art. 2 Due Process
<sup>1</sup> No member may be banned, kicked, or penalized without:
a. formal notice specifying the alleged violation;
b. an explicit citation of the violated law; and
c. an opportunity to submit an appeal.

<sup>2</sup> Temporary actions taken during emergency situations remain subject to review under paragraph 1.

#### Art. 3 Presumption of Innocence
Every member is presumed innocent. The burden of proof rests on the enforcing authority to establish a violation using verifiable evidence.

#### Art. 4 Access to Logs and Records
<sup>1</sup> Members shall have the right to access and view the audit logs, moderation actions, related internal communications, and modifications of laws upon requested.

<sup>2</sup> Information restricted under Article 5 is exempt from public disclosure.

#### Art. 5 Data Protection and Deletion
<sup>1</sup> User messages and IDs are collected solely for moderation and security purposes.

<sup>2</sup> Administrators shall not preserve, and shall immediately delete:
a. unredacted personal information; and
b. Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) or severe illegal content, which shall be deleted and reported to Discord safety.

---

### Section 1: Executive Branch

#### Art. 6 Composition and Duties

<sup>2</sup> The Executive Branch consists of:
a. Lance Administrator;
b. Senior Administrator; and
c. Head Administrator.

<sup>3</sup> Members of the Executive are bound by this Charter and lower codes, and shall not exercise powers beyond those explicitly assigned to their roles.

#### Art. 7 Lance Administrator
<sup>1</sup> Lance Administrators serve as entry-level moderators.

<sup>2</sup> Lance Administrators have the authority to:
a. issue warnings and timeouts under the Penal Code;
b. restrict members to designated channels (*Banishment to the Void*);
c. delete messages that violate rules; and
d. kick members from the server.

<sup>3</sup> Lance Administrators shall not:
a. issue permanent bans;
b. override decisions of higher administrators; or
c. modify roles outside outlined enforcement procedures.

<sup>4</sup> The number of active Lance Administrators is determined by server population:
a. under 40 members: minimum of 1;
b. 40 to 99 members: minimum of 2, maximum of 4;
c. 100 to 299 members: maximum of 6;
d. 300 to 500 members: maximum of 10.

#### Art. 8 Senior Administrator
<sup>1</sup> Senior Administrators supervise Lance Administrators, manage escalated cases, and enforce compliance within the Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> Senior Administrators hold all powers of Lance Administrators, and may:
a. issue temporary or permanent bans; and
b. review and reverse decisions made by Lance Administrators.

<sup>3</sup> Senior Administrators shall not act on disputes in which they are personally involved or reverse decisions of the Head Administrator.

<sup>4</sup> The maximum number of Senior Administrators is calculated as $1 + \log_2(N/20)$ for $N$ total members (minimum of 1 at 20 members).

<sup>1</sup> The Head Administrator oversees operations of the Executive Branch.

<sup>2</sup> The Head Administrator has authority to:
a. appoint, demote, suspend, or remove Executive Branch members;

laws.content:
# SR 120 — The Referendum Act

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted under Chapter 4 of the Server Charter (SR 100). Applies to all members of the server.

---

### Art. 1 Definitions
In this Act:\
a. *active voter* means a member of the server who have cast a vote or interacted with the server in any way in the last 90 days.

### Art. 2 A referendum
<sup>1</sup> Any members of Administration may call a referendum in order to submit a proposed rule change to a vote of the general membership.

<sup>2</sup> Once a referendum is completed, and a majority (50% + 1) of all active voters are in favour of an option, it shall be legally binding. No law shall contradict the referendum.

<sup>3</sup> An option such as 'Abstain' is exempt from paragraph 2 and if a majority are in favor of this option, it shall have no binding effect.

<sup>4</sup> Laws shall be changed immediately to conform to the referendum.

### Art. 3 Voting eligibility
<sup>1</sup> All members of the server shall have the right and are obligated to vote on any referendums by the Administration.

<sup>2</sup> Those who are Banished to The Void are exempt from paragraph 1.

### Art. 4 Viewability
A referendum shall be visible to all members of the server, excluding those who are banished.

### Art. 5 Minimum duration
A referendum shall last at a minimum of three (3) days.

### Art. 6 Documentation
<sup>1</sup> The Director or an appointed worker shall document all referendums.

<sup>2</sup> Starting from 12 Aug. 2026, all referendums shall be numbered sequentially and in the format of `Referendum No. X`.

# SR 210 — Public Code of Member Conduct
*(Public Code)*

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted in accordance to Chapter 4 of the Server Charter (SR 100). Applies to all server members and administrative staff.

---

## Chapter 1: General Provisions

### Art. 1 Scope
The Public Code applies to all members of the server.

### Art. 2 Purpose
The Public Code serves as a public-facing collection of fundamental rules of the server that all members must follow.

### Art. 3 Enforcement
All members of the server must follow the Public Code, violations results in a punishment by Administrators as defined in the Penal Code (SR 310).

## Chapter 2: Specific Provisions

### Section 1: Disclaimers

#### Art. 4 Members’ user data
<sup>1</sup> By participating in this server, members acknowledge that their user data, including but not limited to messages and user IDs; will be collected and logged for moderation purposes. Members may leave the server if they disagree.

<sup>2</sup> Administrators however do not conserve any of the following information:
a. personal information; and
b. illegal materials.

### Section 2: Rights

#### Art. 5 Interpretation and enforcement
Administrators shall not interpret and enforce the rights of members with this section, as that rests with Chapter 1 of the Server Charter (SR 100).

#### Art. 6 Right to view logs
All members have the right to access and view the server audit log, moderation actions, relevant internal communications, and modifications to rules upon request.

#### Art. 7 Right to due process and fair trial
All members have the right to a due process and fair trial if they are punished for a violation.

#### Art. 8 Principle of legality
No member may be punished for an act that was not expressly defined as a crime by any established law at the time it was committed.

### Section 3: General Rules

#### Art. 9 Interaction with other members
<sup>1</sup> Members are to maintain a respectful manner towards other members.

<sup>2</sup> Harmless or even profanity-laced banter towards each other is allowed.

#### Art. 10 Spamming
Members must not spam in such a manner that:
a. clogs up a channel with repeated or useless contents; and
b. disrupts other members' ongoing conversation.

#### Art. 11 Advertisement and self-promotion
Advertisement and self-promotion is permitted if:
a. it is not constant; and
b. it does not disrupt other members' ongoing conversation.

#### Art. 12 Channels
Members are encouraged to use channels for their intended purposes. As described by the channel’s name, description, or formal pinned messages by Administrators.

#### Art. 13 Contents
<sup>1</sup> All contents that other members can view from another member must be safe-for-work.

<sup>2</sup> Members are prohibited from sharing malicious files, attachments, or links.

#### Art. 14 Reporting violations
Members are obligated to report violations to available Administrators.

#### Art. 15 Personal information
<sup>1</sup> Members must not share any personal information that are:
a. home address; and
b. documents with personal identifiable information.

<sup>2</sup> Members are prohibited from sharing any personal identifiable information of other individuals without explicit consent.

#### Art. 16 Impersonation
Members are prohibited from impersonating another individual with the intent to ruin the individual's reputation or mislead others.

#### Art. 17 Voting
Members are obligated to cast a vote on a formal public poll by Administrators when instructed.

b. disrupts other members' ongoing conversation.

#### Art. 11 Advertisement and Self-promotion

a. it is not constant; and
b. it does not disrupt other members' ongoing conversation.

#### Art. 12 Channels
Members are encouraged to use channels for their intended purposes. As described by the channel’s name, description, or formal pinned messages by Administrators.

#### Art. 13 Contents
<sup>1</sup> All contents that other members can view from another member must be safe-for-work.

<sup>2</sup> Members are prohibited from sharing malicious files, attachments, or links.

#### Art. 14 Reporting Violations
Members are obligated to report violations to available Administrators.

#### Art. 15 Personal Information
<sup>1</sup> Members must not share any personal information that are:
a. home address; and
b. documents with personal identifiable information.

<sup>2</sup> Members are prohibited from sharing any personal identifiable information of other individuals without explicit consent.

#### Art. 16 Impersonation
Members are prohibited from impersonating another individual with the intent to ruin the individual's reputation or mislead others.

#### Art. 17 Voting
Members are obligated to cast a vote on a formal public poll by Administrators when instructed.

## Chapter 1: General Provisions

### Section 1: Scope and Application

#### Art. 1 No penalty without a law
A penalty or measure may only be imposed for an act that has been expressly declared to be an offence by law.

#### Art. 2 Scope
<sup>1</sup> This Code applies to any offence committed by any members of the Server on or after the date it comes into force.

<sup>2</sup> For offences committed before the date this Code comes into force, the regulations and penalties in effect at the time of the offence applies.

#### Art. 3 Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines
Members of Administration may ensure contents and behaviours comply with Discord's ToS and Community Guidelines, but can only be punished as defined in Server laws. For any behaviours or contents that violates Discord ToS or Community Guidelines that are undefined or not criminalised in any Server laws, consult to the Head Administrator or Director.

#### Art. 4 Definitions
In this Code:

a. *interactions* means any interaction between members that are:
  1. text messages;
  2. voice messages;
  3. video call;
  4. livestreams; or
  5. voice call.

b. *media* means any content or visual/auditory that can be perceived, accessed, or viewed by another member.

c. *personal information* means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. This includes but not limited to someone's age, legal name, and home address.

d. *to depict* means to represent, portray, or convey through visual, textual, auditory, or roleplayed means, a person, act, or scenario in a manner that a reasonable member would recognise as representing that person, act, or scenario. This includes but is not limited to:
  1. images, videos, GIFs, or other visual media;
  2. written or narrated descriptions, including roleplay or story-format text;
  3. audio recordings, voice acting, or impersonated sounds; and
  4. AI-generated or edited content representing a real or implied individual.

## Chapter 2: Specific Provisions

---

### Section 1: Common Behaviours

#### Art. 5 Ping abuse
<sup>1</sup> Ping abuse means pinging another member without their consent and that serves no purpose and is purely intended to annoy or harass.

<sup>2</sup> A member repeatedly pinging another member in large amounts receives:\
a. a 5-minute timeout on the first offence;\
b. subsequent offences or more raises the duration in minutes by multiplying the last time out duration by 2;\
c. if they persist after their timeout with the duration of 1 week or more, they must be kicked.

#### Art. 6 Spamming
<sup>1</sup> Spamming is prohibited if it:
a. disrupts anyone’s ongoing conversation of the channel(s) being spammed; or
b. clogs a channel with meaningless or repeated content

<sup>2</sup> Violation of paragraph 1 must be punished by timeout, with the duration under an Administrator's discretion, maximum 3 days.

<sup>3</sup> Above 3 repeated offences must be punishable by a kick.

<sup>4</sup> Administrators may delete spam contents if requested.

#### Art. 7 Advertising or self-promotion
<sup>1</sup> Any kinds of advertising or self-promotion must only be punishable if:
a. the advertising is constant or disruptive to other members; or
b. the advertiser’s sole intention in the server is to advertise.

<sup>2</sup> Any member violating paragraph 1 must receive:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 2-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 4-hour timeout on the third offence;
d. a kick on the fourth offence.

---

### Section 2: Accounts and Identity

#### Art. 8 Personal information
<sup>1</sup> Members must not share any documents containing personal identifiable information.

<sup>2</sup> Such information defined in paragraph 1 must be deleted immediately, including from any moderation logs.

<sup>3</sup> Any user who shares any personal information of another individual without their consent must be banned immediately.

#### Art. 9 Impersonation
<sup>1</sup> Members must not impersonate with the intent to:
a. deceive or mislead others into believing they are another natural individual; or:
b. making false claims of that individual.

<sup>2</sup> Members violating paragraph 1 must receive:\
a. a warning on the first offence; and
b. a kick on the second offence.

#### Art. 10 Alternative accounts
<sup>1</sup> Members must not use alternative accounts to:\
a. gain an extra vote on a poll; or\
b. bypass punishments.

<sup>2</sup> Members violating paragraph 1 must be permanently banned along with their alternative accounts.

---

### Section 3: Grave Unsolicited Behaviours and Contents

#### Art. 11 Removal of contents
<sup>1</sup> Administrators must immediately delete any of the contents defined in all Articles under Section 3 that constitutes a violation.

<sup>2</sup> Where the violating content is not directly deletable by an Administrator (e.g. member profile pictures, banners, description), they must instead require the member to remove or change the content.

<sup>3</sup> For profile contents depicting sexual contents, realistic gore, or other distressing contents, the member must be kicked immediately. An Administrator must then DM them stating the specific content and provision violated, and order its removal or change. Recurrence of contents violating the same provision, regardless of superficial differences, must be treated as a continued violation.

<sup>4</sup> For all other violations, an Administrator must DM the member stating the specific content and provision violated, and order its removal or change within 48 hours. An Administrator may set a different time frame where the nature of the content, technical limitations, or the member's circumstances warrant it, stating the reason. Failure to comply within the applicable time frame must be treated as a continued violation.

<sup>5</sup> A member may request review of a determination under this Article by another Administrator.

#### Art. 12 Files and links
<sup>1</sup> The sharing of files or other downloadable attachments containing malicious code, malware, viruses, trojans, ransomware, spyware, or keyloggers must be punishable by an instant ban.

<sup>2</sup> Sharing links, drive folders, or external repositories that directly host or lead to malicious files or phishing pages is treated identically to direct file uploads and has the same punishment defined in paragraph 1.

<sup>3</sup> Files or attachments that are not necessarily harmful but cause temporary disruptions such as temporarily corrupting the rendering of the Discord application, the sender must be warned. Repeated behaviours must lead to a timeout. After four counts, the sender must be kicked.

#### Art. 13 Non-consensual romantic pairings
<sup>1</sup> Members must not pair, “ship”, or depict real individuals of the server in romantic or sexual contexts in any media or interaction, without prior explicit consent from all parties depicted.

<sup>2</sup> Members violating paragraph 1 must receive:
a. a 24-hour timeout on the first offence; and:
b. a kick on the second offence.

<sup>3</sup> Such contents must be removed upon request by any individuals depicted.

#### Art. 14 Forced feminisation and grooming[^1]
<sup>1</sup> Members are prohibited from instructing, coercing, or persistently "encouraging" other members to don specific garments, adopt specific personas, or engage in behaviours that are recognised as elements of sexual roleplay, psychological fetishes, or sexual submissiveness. 

<sup>2</sup> The non-consensual application of behaviours defined in paragraph 1 onto other members must constitute:
a. a 12-hour timeout on the first offence;
b. a kick on the second offence; and
c. a ban on the third offence.

<sup>3</sup> The presentation of media as a humorous image, macro, trend, or ‘meme’ does not grant exemption from the provisions of this Article.

#### Art. 15 Violence and gore
<sup>1</sup> Members must not depict:
a. extreme physical violence;
b. real footage of psychological harm;
c. sexual violence;
d. serious bodily injury; and
e. content fetishising these imagery.

<sup>2</sup> Violations of paragraph 1 are punishable by a permanent ban.

<sup>3</sup> The following does not constitute a violation if the sender is using a spoiler tag or in a dedicated NSFW channel:\
a. medias that depict surgical operations in a clinical context;\
b. medias depicting real war footage; and\
c. arts depicting violence and blood.

#### Art. 16 Sexual and suggestive media and interactions
<sup>1</sup> Not Safe for Work (NSFW) means anything which includes media or interactions; that is reasonably considered inappropriate, explicit, or intrusive to be viewed, heard, or engaged with in public spaces, workplaces, or shared social and domestic environments.

<sup>2</sup> Members interacting in a way that depicts or implies an explicit sexual act must receive:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 2-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 4-hour timeout on the third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth offence.

<sup>3</sup> Members discussing sexual acts, preferences or characters or persons in any channel not designated for NSFW contents, must receive:
a. a warning on the first offence to move their discussion to a designated channel for NSFW contents;
b. a 2-hour timeout on their second offence for failure to move their discussion;
c. a 12-hour timeout on their third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth offence.

<sup>3a</sup> Members discussing the size, girth, dimensions, or other measurements or qualities of genitalia or sexual anatomy, whether their own, another member's, or hypothetical, outside a designated NSFW channel, must receive the same punishment ladder as paragraph 3.

<sup>4</sup> Members depicting specific gestures, facial expressions, or movements that is otherwise only made during or to represent sexual acts, they must receive:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 4-hour timeout on the second through fourth offences; and
c. a kick on the fifth offence.

<sup>5</sup> Any depiction of explicit sexual acts, nudity, and adult novelties is punishable by:
a. a 24-hour timeout on the first offence;
b. a 48-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 1-week timeout on the third and fourth offence; and
d. a kick on the fifth offence.

<sup>6</sup> For the purposes of paragraph 4, prohibited depictions include, but are not limited to:
a. masturbation even if clothed;
b. sexual acts even if cropped;
c. presence of fluids that is made for, during or as a result of sexual acts;
d. intentional physical contact of sex organs and other organs for sexual pleasure;
e. clothing specifically designed for sexual pleasure;
f. sexual acts done by other species besides humans; and
g. sexual organs clearly visible through clothing.

<sup>7</sup> Media that only includes the following and does not depict anything above does not constitute a violation:
a. adult novelties that do not necessarily have the form of a sex organ; and
b. fine arts depicting nudity.

<sup>8</sup> For fine arts where a significant portion of the medium is nudity, the sender is required to put a spoiler tag or move to a designated NSFW channel. Failure to do this must result in:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. 1-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. 1-day timeout on the third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth violation.

<sup>9</sup> Members must not depict any media where the main content or major portions of it are depictions of suggestive closeups of specific body parts including:
a. buttocks;
b. feet;
c. armpits;
d. breast;
e. pelvic or genitalia region;
f. thighs; and
g. abdomen.

<sup>10</sup> Violation of paragraph 9 must be punishable by:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 1-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 48-hour timeout on the third offence;
d. a 1-week timeout on the fourth offence; and
e. a kick on the fifth offence.

---

### Section 4: Minor Unsolicited Behaviours and Contents

#### Art. 17 Incitement[^2]
The incitement, endorsement, or encouragement to commit a violation of law, disrupt or threaten the order, peace, and unity of the server is punishable by no less than 1-week timeout and a 6000₣ fine.

#### Art. 18 General member conduct
<sup>1</sup> The explicit disrespect against the death of another member's friend, family member, pet, or significant other is punishable by:
a. a 1-week timeout from the first through the third offence; and
b. an indefinite banishment to the Void until the victim forgives them.


[^1]: Adopted unilaterally by The Director on 19 June 2026, in force since 19 June 2026.
[^2]: Adopted unilaterally by The Director on 14 Aug. 2026, in force since 14 Aug. 2026.

<sup>1</sup> Administrators shall immediately delete any of the contents defined in all Articles under Section 3 that constitutes a violation.

<sup>2</sup> Where the violating content is not directly deletable by an Administrator (e.g. member profile pictures, banners, description), they shall instead require the member to remove or change the content.

<sup>3</sup> For profile contents depicting sexual contents, realistic gore, or other distressing contents, the member shall be kicked immediately. An Administrator shall then DM them stating the specific content and provision violated, and order its removal or change. Recurrence of contents violating the same provision, regardless of superficial differences, shall be treated as a continued violation.

<sup>4</sup> For all other violations, an Administrator shall DM the member stating the specific content and provision violated, and order its removal or change within 48 hours. An Administrator may set a different time frame where the nature of the content, technical limitations, or the member's circumstances warrant it, stating the reason. Failure to comply within the applicable time frame shall be treated as a continued violation.

<sup>5</sup> A member may request review of a determination under this Article by another Administrator.

#### Art. 12 Files and links
<sup>1</sup> The sharing of files or other downloadable attachments containing malicious code, malware, viruses, trojans, ransomware, spyware, or keyloggers shall be punishable by an instant ban.

<sup>2</sup> Sharing links, drive folders, or external repositories that directly host or lead to malicious files or phishing pages is treated identically to direct file uploads and has the same punishment defined in paragraph 1.

<sup>3</sup> Files or attachments that are not necessarily harmful but cause temporary disruptions such as temporarily corrupting the rendering of the Discord application, the sender shall be warned. Repeated behaviours shall lead to a timeout. After four counts, the sender shall be kicked.

#### Art. 13 Non-consensual romantic pairings
<sup>1</sup> Members shall not pair, “ship”, or depict real individuals of the server in romantic and / or sexual contexts in any media or interaction, without prior explicit consent from all the parties depicted.

<sup>2</sup> Members violating paragraph 1 shall receive:
a. a 24-hour timeout on the first offence; and:
b. a kick on the second offence.

<sup>3</sup> Such contents shall be removed upon request by any individuals depicted.

#### Art. 14 Forced feminization and grooming[^1]
<sup>1</sup> Members are prohibited from instructing, coercing, or persistently "encouraging" other members to don specific garments, adopt specific personas, or engage in behaviours that are recognised as elements of sexual roleplay, psychological fetishes, or sexual submissiveness. 

<sup>2</sup> The non-consensual application of behaviours defined in paragraph 1 onto other members shall constitute:
a. a 12-hour timeout on the first offence;
b. a kick on the second offence; and
c. a ban on the third offence.

<sup>3</sup> The presentation of media as a humorous image, macro, trend, or ‘meme’ does not grant exemption from the provisions of this Article.

#### Art. 15 Violence and gore
<sup>1</sup> Members shall not post or have media that depicts:
a. extreme physical violence;
b. real footage of psychological harm;
c. sexual violence;
d. serious bodily injury; and
e. content fetishising these imagery.

<sup>2</sup> Violations of paragraph 1 are punishable by a permanent ban.

<sup>3</sup> The following does not constitute a violation if the sender is using a spoiler tag or in a dedicated NSFW channel:\
a. medias that depict surgical operations in a clinical context;\
b. medias depicting real war footages; and\
c. arts depicting violence and blood.

#### Art. 16 Sexual and suggestive media and interactions
<sup>1</sup> Not Safe for Work, abbreviated as NSFW, shall be defined as anything which includes media or interactions; that is reasonably considered inappropriate, explicit, or intrusive to be viewed, heard, or engaged with in public spaces, workplaces, or shared social and domestic environments without the explicit consent or prior warning of those present.

<sup>2</sup> Members interacting in a way that depicts or implies an explicit sexual act shall receive:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 2-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 4-hour timeout on the third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth offence.

<sup>3</sup> Members discussing sexual acts, preferences and / or characters or persons in any channel not designated for NSFW contents, shall receive:
a. a warning on the first offence to move their discussion to a designated channel for NSFW contents;
b. a 2-hour timeout on their second offence for failure to move their discussion;
c. a 12-hour timeout on their third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth offence.

<sup>3a</sup> Members discussing the size, girth, dimensions, or other measurements or qualities of genitalia or sexual anatomy, whether their own, another member's, or hypothetical, outside a designated NSFW channel, shall receive the same punishment ladder as paragraph 3.

<sup>4</sup> Members depicting specific gestures, facial expressions, or movements that is otherwise only made during or to represent sexual acts, they shall receive:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 4-hour timeout on the second through fourth offences; and
c. a kick on the fifth offence.

<sup>5</sup> Any depiction of explicit sexual acts, nudity, and adult novelties is punishable by:
a. a 24-hour timeout on the first offence;
b. a 48-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 1-week timeout on the third and fourth offence; and
d. a kick on the fifth offence.

<sup>6</sup> For the purposes of paragraph 4, prohibited depictions include, but are not limited to:
a. masturbation even if clothed;
b. sexual acts even if cropped;
c. presence of fluids that is made for, during and / or as a result of sexual acts;
d. intentional physical contact of sex organs and other organs for sexual pleasure;
e. clothing specifically designed for sexual pleasure;
f. sexual acts done by other species besides humans; and
g. sexual organs clearly visible through clothing.

<sup>7</sup> Media that only includes the following and does not depict anything above does not constitute a violation:
a. adult novelties that do not necessarily have the form of a sex organ; and
b. fine arts depicting nudity.

<sup>8</sup> For fine arts where a significant portion of the medium is nudity, the sender is required to put a spoiler tag or move to a designated NSFW channel. Failure to do this shall result in:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. 1-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. 1-day timeout on the third offence; and
d. a kick on the fourth violation.

<sup>9</sup> Members shall not depict any media where the main content or major portions of it are depictions of suggestive closeups of specific body parts including:
a. buttocks;
b. feet;
c. armpits;
d. breast;
e. pelvic or genitalia region; and
f. thighs;

<sup>10</sup> Violation of paragraph 9 shall be punishable by:
a. a warning on the first offence;
b. a 1-hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a 48-hour timeout on the third offence;
d. a 1-week timeout on the fourth offence; and
e. a kick on the fifth offence.

### Section 4: Minor Unsolicited Behaviours and Contents

#### Art. 17 Incitement[^2]
The incitement, endorsement, or encouragement to commit a violation of law, disrupt or threaten the order, peace, and unity of the server shall be punishable by no less than 1-week timeout and a 6000₣ fine.

#### Art. 18 General member conduct
<sup>1</sup> The explicit disrespect against the death of another member's friend, family member, pet, or significant other shall be punishable by:
a. a 1-week timeout from the first through the third offence; and
b. an indefinite banishment to the Void until the victim forgives them.

# SR 310 — Penal Code

> **Enactment Notice:** Enacted in accordance to Chapter 4 of the Server Charter (SR 100). Applies to all server members and members of administration.

## Chapter 1: General Provisions

### Section 1: Scope and Terminology

#### Art. 1. Purpose
The Penal Code shall define the punishments Administrators are required to punish members for violations of the Public Code.

#### Art. 2. Scope
The Penal Code shall apply to all members of the server.

#### Art. 3. Discord Terms of Service and Community Guidelines
Members of Administration may ensure contents and behaviours comply with Discord's ToS and Community Guidelines, but can only be punished as defined in this Penal Code. For any behaviours or contents that violates Discord ToS or Community Guidelines that are undefined and / or not criminalised in this Penal Code, consult to the Head Administrator or Director.

#### Art. 4. Definitions
<sup>1</sup> For the purposes of this Code, the following terms shall be defined as:\
a. *interactions* means any interaction between members that are:
  1. text messages;
  2. voice messages;
  3. video call;
  4. livestreams; and / or
  5. voice call.

b. *media* means any content or visual/auditory that can be perceived, accessed, or viewed by another member.

c. *personal information* means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person. This includes but not limited to someone's age, legal name, and home address.

d. *to depict* means to represent, portray, or convey through visual, textual, auditory, or roleplayed means, a person, act, or scenario in a manner that a reasonable member would recognise as representing that person, act, or scenario. This includes but is not limited to:
  1. images, videos, GIFs, or other visual media;
  2. written or narrated descriptions, including roleplay or story-format text;
  3. audio recordings, voice acting, or impersonated sounds; and
  4. AI-generated or edited content representing a real or implied individual.

<sup>1</sup> Ping abuse shall be defined as pinging another member without their consent and that serves no purpose and is purely intended to annoy or harass.

a. a five (5) minute timeout on the first offence;\
b. subsequent offences or more shall raise the duration in minutes by multiplying the last time out duration by 2;\
c. if they persist after their timeout with the duration of 1 week or more, they shall be kicked.

a. disrupts anyone’s ongoing conversation of the channel(s) being spammed; and / or
b. clogs a channel with meaningless and / or repeated content

<sup>1</sup> Any kinds of advertising or self-promotion shall only be punishable if:
a. the advertising is constant and/or disruptive to other members; and / or
b. the advertiser’s sole intention in the server is to advertise.

b. a two (2) hour timeout on the second offence;
c. a four (4) hour timeout on the third offence;
d. a kick on the fourth offence.
